top_signals.title: Anthropic’s growth slows ahead of IPO as AI spending bill nears $900bn
top_signals.summary: Anthropic’s revenue has surged twelvefold to nearly $17bn (£13bn), but the AI giant has slipped back into the red as its computing commitments approach $900bn ahead of a potentially record-breaking stock market debut. top_signals.title: Seven Migrants Die Offshore Canary Islands
top_signals.summary: At least seven migrants died off Spain's Canary Islands while more than 380 people were rescued on Monday, the country's maritime rescue services said.Two deceased people were found aboard a migrant boat when the coast guard rescued 132 people on Monday, 150 km (94 miles) off Lanzarote.
